name: meta
listed_description: Header-only, non-intrusive and macro-free runtime reflection system in C++.
reason: No numeric comparison against any baseline. README (opened) and repo tree (src, test, docs, cmake, deps; no benchmark dir) only claim near-zero allocations through small buffer optimisation, with no numbers. Repo archived by owner 2025-05-08; successor lives inside EnTT. Searches found no third-party shootout including it.

name: mINI
reason: No numbers anywhere reachable. README, CHANGELOG.md and repo tree (src/mini, tests; no benchmark dir) carry only design claims (header-only, lazy writing). Searches for an INI parser shootout found only Rust and Perl parsers, none listing mINI.

name: Mini-XML
listed_description: A small XML parsing library written in ANSI C.
reason: No numeric comparison. README, CHANGES.md and repo tree opened: emphasis is small size, no benchmark directory, no performance numbers. Search for XML shootouts including mxml returned only expat vs libxml2 pages; pugixml.org/benchmark and zeux.io are EGRESS_BLOCKED so whether mxml appears there is unverified.

name: mini-yaml
reason: No numbers. README only advises using references to avoid copies; tree has yaml, examples, test, no benchmark. Search found rapidyaml's 'is it rapid' page comparing ryml with yaml-cpp and others, no mini-yaml row seen in snippets (page itself not opened, readthedocs blocked).

name: minIni
reason: No numbers. README claims small size (under a thousand lines), no dynamic allocation, deterministic memory footprint, fewer flash writes at the cost of double reads; all directional, no measured comparison. Tree has dev, doc only.

name: Nameof
listed_description: Header-only C++17 library provides nameof macros and functions to obtain the simple name of variable, type, function, macro, and enum.
reason: Directional claim only: README says NAMEOF_ENUM_CONST has 'a lower compile-time cost' than NAMEOF_ENUM, with no numbers, and that is an internal variant not a named external baseline. Tree has doc, example, include, test; no benchmark dir. CHANGELOG.md 404. Searches found no third-party enum-name shootout with numbers for nameof (feedbagel.com C++26 enum-to-string benchmark post is EGRESS_BLOCKED, content unseen).

name: REFLECT
reason: Only self-timing, no baseline. README is a symlink to the header file; its Performance section shows assembly for type_name, member_name, enum_name, and its Compilation times section gives the header's own include time (g++-13.2 0.113s with -DNTEST, 0.253s without; clang++-17 0.119s, 0.322s) with no comparison. FAQ lists boost.pfr, glaze, reflect-cpp, magic_enum only as 'similar projects'. The r/cpp post 'Optimized enum_to_name and name_to_enum with no bloat' (t.me) is EGRESS_BLOCKED.
